subject: Data on a US county map

messages.author: 1618b6fb669a2ac6
messages.subject: Data on a US county map
parts:
Hi,

I would like to use the US county map in the "mapdata package" and
plot a count variable for each county. I would like to plot this data
on the county map so that the county with the highest value is black
and the county with the lowest value is white (and a range of grey in
between). I've been searching for an example but haven't found one
yet. Any suggestions on how to do this in R? Thanks!

Mathijs

messages.author: 1618b6fb669a2ac6
messages.subject: Re: Data on a US county map
parts:
Thanks! I am almost there, but there are a few things that I cannot
figure out. I've used the following code:

setwd("C:/Users")
library(rgdal)
county.map <- readOGR(dsn="C:/Users", layer="UScounties")
save(county.map, file="countymap.rdata")
library(maptools)
gpclibPermit()
load("countymap.rdata")
library(ggplot2)
county.ggmap <- fortify(county.map, region = "FIPS")
prod<-read.table(file="map_data.csv",header=TRUE,sep=",",colClasses =
"character")
county.ggmape <- merge(county.ggmap, prod, by = "id", all = TRUE)
county.ggmape <- county.ggmape[order(county.ggmape$order), ]
county.plot <- ggplot(data = county.ggmape, aes(x = long, y = lat,
group = group))
county.plot + geom_polygon(aes(fill = prod)) + labs(x = "Longitude", y
=
"Latitude", fill = "Density") + opts(title = "Firms per FIPS")

The prod data.frame contains the values for each county and ranges
from 0 to 57.
How do I:

1. assign colors to a group of values instead of a color for every
unique value? Example: 0-4 = white, 5-9 = grey, >9 = black
2. limit the map to the lower 48, so leaving out Hawaii and Alaska?

Thanks!

Best,

Mathijs

messages.subject: Re: Data on a US county map
parts:
I've solved my previous questions, but two more questions pop up:

1. I've assigned a factor to each county value, which results in 5
groups (counties with 0-4, 5-9, 10-14, 15-19, or >19 firms). How do I
logically order these 5 groups in the legend?
2. Related to 1: how do I assign colors to these groups? Preferably a
gradient with 0-4 = "white and >19 = "black".

Thanks!
